essential_clues: Loaded charcoal dray is rolling downhill; an open side strip reaches its flank.
The bathhouse door behind Wurdren is clear; workers near the gate can be warned.
Bathhouse serves charcoal workers and forest wardens.
A supply load is on a new priority contract.
A shared meal is available and the bathhouse is losing heat through a damaged flue.
A partial opening might be possible with repairs and agreement.
New paid contracts send charcoal toward higher-paying Ironcrest work.
Drivers are following actual orders, not necessarily committing theft.

scenes.location: Old water channel behind the bathhouse
essential_clues: A practical repair or insulation can reduce fuel demand.
A safe repair needs assistance, materials and time.
A locally negotiated limited heating arrangement permits the bathhouse to open; participants remember who helped.
The bathhouse shuts temporarily; townspeople make their own workarounds and the relationships endure.
